dialog.minted_coins.menu.title: Minted Coins
dialog.minted_coins.menu.body: Banks set the coins of a currency; their mints are merchants that strike these coins from ingots. Coins can only come from a mint, so nobody can counterfeit them.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.new.tooltip: Create a currency: the names and rates of its coins. Its mints are placed from its page.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.list.tooltip: Every bank with its mints, to place a new mint, teleport to one, edit them or remove them.
dialog.minted_coins.menu.help.tooltip: How banks, mints, coins, names and editing work, and who can use this menu.
dialog.minted_coins.create.small: Small change (1 coin = as many small coins as coins per ingot)
dialog.minted_coins.create.confirm.toolt: Mints offering conversion melt the coins back without loss, at these rates. At a crafting table, 9 coins give 1 ingot.
dialog.minted_coins.help.title: Minted Coins help
dialog.minted_coins.help.mint: A bank sets a currency: the names, rates, small change and conversion order of its coins. It takes the name typed in the Bank name field. Left empty, it is named after the renamed item in your main hand (a name tag renamed in an anvil, for instance), otherwise "Bank #N".
dialog.minted_coins.help.coins: Coins take the names typed in the coin name fields. Left empty, they are named after a renamed gold, copper or iron nugget, or renamed prismarine crystals, in your inventory (otherwise "Gold Coin", "Copper Coin", "Iron Coin" and "Diamond Coin"). These items are only read, not consumed.
dialog.minted_coins.help.rates: At a crafting table, 9 coins always give back 1 ingot. Mints offering conversion melt coins without loss, at the rates of their bank; the buyback changes 9 diamond coins of the bank for 1 diamond.
dialog.minted_coins.help.small: With small change, the mints also change each coin into small coins, as many as the bank strikes coins per ingot (or per diamond), and change them back the same way. Their name follows the small coin name typed in the menu, where %%s stands for the coin name (Small %%s by default).
dialog.minted_coins.help.conversion: Conversion: mints offering it melt their bank's coins back into ingots (or diamonds) without loss, as many coins as the bank strikes per ingot for 1 ingot. They exchange coins struck under a former name for current coins, one for one, and change 64 coins of a number into 1 coin of the next number, and back (each coin has a number, 0 = not converted; by default copper 1, iron 2, gold 3, diamond 4). With "coins of every bank", the mint also melts the coins of the other banks, at the rates of each.
dialog.minted_coins.help.edit: Edit bank… on the page of a bank changes its names, rates, small change and conversion order: all its mints follow. Coins struck before a renaming keep their old name: the mints exchange them one for one for coins under the new name. Edit… on the page of a mint changes its name and its trades.
dialog.minted_coins.help.purse: Each mint sells the purse of its bank for 1 leather and 1 string. It works like a bundle, without limit: put coins of its bank in it, take them out, choose which ones. It shows up to 32 coins, keeps the rest in reserve and shows more as you take them out. Anything else is handed back.
dialog.minted_coins.help.access: Operators open this menu with /function minted_coins:mint/menu, which also lets them open it later with /trigger minted_coins.mint.menu. Creating or editing a bank or a mint runs an operator command: Minecraft asks you to confirm it.
dialog.minted_coins.list.title: Banks
dialog.minted_coins.list.body: Choose a bank to see its mints, place a new one, edit the bank or remove it.
dialog.minted_coins.remove.title: Remove the mint?
dialog.minted_coins.remove.body: Remove the mint %s? Coins it already struck belong to its bank and stay valid.
chat.minted_coins.no_coin: Choose at least one coin to strike.
chat.minted_coins.same_rank: Two coins have the same conversion order: give each coin its own number, or 0.
dialog.minted_coins.edit.title: Edit %s
dialog.minted_coins.edit.body: Changes apply to every mint of the bank. Leave a name empty to keep the current one. Renamed coins: the coins already struck keep their old name, and the mints exchange them one for one for new ones. Set a slider to 0 to stop striking a coin. Conversion order: 64 coins are worth 1 coin of the next number (0 = not converted).
dialog.minted_coins.edit.confirm.tooltip: Every mint of the bank rebuilds its trades. A coin set to 0 is no longer struck, changed or bought back by its mints.
chat.minted_coins.not_operator: Only operators can open the Minted Coins menu. An operator opens it once with /function minted_coins:mint/menu; after that, /trigger minted_coins.mint.menu is enough.
chat.minted_coins.revoked: Your access to the Minted Coins menu has been removed.
chat.minted_coins.purse.rejected: Only coins of %s go in this purse
dialog.minted_coins.bank.body: Every mint of the bank strikes its coins, under its names and at its rates, and takes back the coins of the other mints. Each mint only offers the trades chosen for it.
dialog.minted_coins.bank.edit.tooltip: Names, rates, small change and conversion order of the coins, for every mint of the bank.
dialog.minted_coins.bank.new_mint.toolti: Place a mint of this bank 2 blocks in front of you and choose its trades.
dialog.minted_coins.bank.remove.body: Remove the bank %s and all its mints? Coins already struck keep their names, but no mint changes them or buys them back any more.
dialog.minted_coins.bank.remove.title: Remove the bank?
dialog.minted_coins.bank_create.body: A bank sets the coins of its currency: names, rates, small change and conversion order. Its mints, placed from its page, strike them. An empty name is taken from a renamed item, as explained in Help…, or keeps its default. Set a slider to 0 to leave a coin out. Conversion order: 64 coins are worth 1 coin of the next number (0 = not converted).
dialog.minted_coins.bank_create.title: New bank
dialog.minted_coins.help.mints: Mints are placed from the page of their bank, 2 blocks in front of you. They all strike the coins of the bank, and each one takes back the coins struck by the others. Each mint only offers the trades ticked for it: strike, small change, conversion, diamond buyback, purse.
dialog.minted_coins.mint_form.body: The mint strikes the coins of its bank, under its names and at its rates. Choose the trades it offers: the others are left out.
dialog.minted_coins.mint_form.confirm.to: The trades the bank doesn't have (a coin it doesn't strike, small change it doesn't offer) are left out anyway.
dialog.minted_coins.mint_form.name: Mint name (empty = name of the bank)
dialog.minted_coins.bank.new_exchange.to: Place an exchange office of this bank 2 blocks in front of you: it changes the coins of other banks for those of this bank.
dialog.minted_coins.exchange_form.name: Exchange office name (empty = Exchange office of <bank>)
dialog.minted_coins.exchange_form.body: The exchange office changes the coins of the ticked banks for coins of its bank, and back, metal by metal. For the coins given, it gives back the metal of the coins given back: 10 given and 9 given back is 10 coins for 9 between two banks at the same rate. Between different rates, the trade follows the metal of the coins (the coins each bank strikes per ingot).
dialog.minted_coins.exchange_form.confir: Only the coins both banks strike are changed. Small coins are not.
dialog.minted_coins.exchange_form.alone: There is no other bank yet: create one first, then tick it here.
dialog.minted_coins.help.exchange: Exchange offices are placed from the page of their bank too. They change the coins of the banks ticked for them for coins of their bank, and back, metal by metal, at the rate set for them: for the coins given, the metal of the coins given back (10 given → 9 back, for instance). Small coins are not changed.
chat.minted_coins.shop.closed: ✔ Shop closed: %s. The container is unlocked and your licence is back.
chat.minted_coins.shop.full: A shop has 12 offers at most: remove one first.
chat.minted_coins.shop.key_goods: A shop key can't be sold.
chat.minted_coins.shop.locked: This container is already locked, maybe by another shop.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_bank: The bank that issued this licence no longer exists.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_container: Look at a chest or barrel while using the licence.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_goods: Hold the goods in your main hand.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_key: You need the key of this shop.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_name: Hold an item renamed in an anvil, a name tag for instance.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_price: Hold the price, in coins, in your off hand.
chat.minted_coins.shop.no_room: The merchant needs 3 free blocks above the container.
chat.minted_coins.shop.none: Click the sign above a shop first.
chat.minted_coins.shop.opened: ✔ Shop opened. Keep its key: hold it to open the stock, and click the sign above the merchant to set its offers.
chat.minted_coins.shop.visitor: %s: trade with the merchant. Only the holder of its key manages it.
dialog.minted_coins.mint_form.licence: Shop licence, at the price set by the bank
dialog.minted_coins.shop.body: Hold the goods in your main hand and their price, in coins, in your off hand: the stack sizes give the quantity and the price. Sell: customers pay the coins and get the goods from the stock. Buy: they give the goods and get the coins from the stock.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.buy: Buy: main hand for off hand
dialog.minted_coins.shop.buy.tooltip: Customers give the goods in your main hand and get the coins in your off hand, paid from the stock.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.close.body: The merchant leaves and the container is unlocked, with everything in it. You get your licence back.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.close.title: Close the shop?
dialog.minted_coins.shop.offers_count: Offers: %s. Its stock is in the container under the merchant; the holder of its key manages it.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.remove.body: The merchant leaves and the container is unlocked (when it is loaded), with everything in it. The licence is not handed back.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.remove.title: Remove the shop?
dialog.minted_coins.shop.rename.tooltip: Takes the name of the item in your main hand, a name tag renamed in an anvil for instance.
dialog.minted_coins.shop.sell: Sell: main hand for off hand
dialog.minted_coins.shop.sell.tooltip: Customers pay the coins in your off hand and get the goods in your main hand, taken from the stock.
lore.minted_coins.key_use: Hold it to open the stock; carry it to manage the shop
lore.minted_coins.licence_use: Use it while looking at a chest or barrel
dialog.minted_coins.help.shops: Players open shops with a licence sold by the mints (its price is set for each bank). Used while looking at a chest or barrel, it places a merchant on it and gives a key: the container becomes the stock, and only opens for whoever holds the key. Carrying the key, click the sign above the merchant to add offers: goods in the main hand, price in coins in the off hand.
dialog.minted_coins.mint_form.convert_al: Conversion: coins of every bank → ingots
